plain: Lending money at very high interest, especially above what the law allows

webster.text: Formerly, interest; or a premium paid or stipulated to be paid for the use of money.

more.text: In present usage, illegal interest; a premium or compensation paid or stipulated to be paid for the use of money borrowed or retained, beyond the rate of interest established by law.

example.quote: These were added to the accursed practice of letting money at usury, and some few real difficulties and grievances, which our late situation unavoidably brought upon us.
example.cite: John DeWitt I, Boston American Herald, Oct. 22, 1787
